story_zh: 小明饿了，他去餐厅吃饭。他点了一碗面条和一杯茶。面条里有鸡蛋和羊肉，很好吃。他还想吃水果，所以点了一个苹果和一块西瓜。吃完后，他喝了一杯水。今天他吃得很开心！
story_pinyin: Xiǎo Míng è le, tā qù cāntīng chī fàn. Tā diǎn le yī wǎn miàntiáo hé yī bēi chá. Miàntiáo lǐ yǒu jīdàn hé yángròu, hěn hǎochī. Tā hái xiǎng chī shuǐguǒ, suǒyǐ diǎn le yī gè píngguǒ hé yī kuài xīguā. Chī wán hòu, tā hē le yī bēi shuǐ. Jīntiān tā chī dé hěn kāixīn!
story_en: Xiao Ming is hungry, so he goes to a restaurant to eat. He orders a bowl of noodles and a cup of tea. The noodles have eggs and lamb, which are very tasty. He also wants to eat fruit, so he orders an apple and a piece of watermelon. After eating, he drinks a glass of water. Today he eats very happily!
